reveals.label: What that session was getting at

content.text: Staying safe and guarded on the mat before you trust a partner is the same guard you run before you trust a room. Both are smart. Naming it is the work.

body.text: From the top, stay under both elbows and keep the connection alive as the partner works. It is continuous, no single finish, just holding real contact.
As the real you, not a performance. That is who you are with other people now.

content.text: Any of the three ends the round immediately. When your partner taps, you stop. Not after you finish the move. Immediately.

slides.title: How you win it
slides.question: In Mount, Stay Under Both Elbows, what counts as the win?

options.text: Staying under both elbows and keeping the connection alive continuously
options.feedback: That is the win condition, and nothing else scores.

options.text: Holding the finish after your partner taps
options.feedback: Never. Every finish is released instantly on the tap, every time. The tap is law.
You keep the pin by feeling your partner and adjusting, not by clamping and squeezing. Staying calm and adjusting beats forcing harder.

slides.correctText: That is the whole win condition for today.
